text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Access(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
CanCompose(x) ::: x can compose.
WantsToCompose(x) ::: x wants to compose.
Compose(x) ::: x composes.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → WantsToCompose(george) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
Access(george, program) → CanCompose(george) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
CanCompose(george) ∧ WantsToCompose(george) → Compose(george) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
Likes(george, music) ∧ Access(george, program) → Compose(george) ::: If George likes music and has access to a program, he will compose.
